definition: memoQ is a translation management system (TMS) and translation technology platform that runs on Microsoft Windows operating systems.
details: It is developed by the Hungarian software company memoQ Fordítástechnológiai Zrt. (memoQ Translation Technologies), formerly Kilgray, a provider of translation management software established in 2004 and cited as one of the fastest-growing companies in the translation technology sector in 2012, and 2013. memoQ provides translation memory, terminology management, machine translation and AI-assisted translation integration, workflow automation, and collaborative localization features in desktop, client/server and web-based environments.

explainer.lead: memoQ is a translation management system and translation technology platform that runs on Microsoft Windows. It bundles translation memory, terminology management, machine translation and AI-assisted translation integration, workflow automation, and collaborative localization.

tiers.eli5: A workspace for translators that remembers past translations and shares them across a team.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers and translators use it to combine translation memory, terminology management, machine translation integration, and collaborative localization in one platform.
tiers.paperLevel: A translation management system (TMS) and translation technology platform running on Microsoft Windows, developed by the Hungarian company memoQ Fordítástechnológiai Zrt. (formerly Kilgray), a translation management software provider established in 2004.

explainer.example: A localization team reuses stored translations from the translation memory while integrating machine translation for new segments in a collaborative workflow.
